CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.acces_collaborateur_autorise(p_email text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(p_email, '') <> ''
     and exists (
       select 1 from public.utilisateurs u
       where lower(btrim(u.email)) = p_email and u.actif is true)
     and not exists (
       select 1 from public.utilisateurs u
       where lower(btrim(u.email)) = p_email and u.actif is not true);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.est_ouvrier()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.mon_role() = 'ouvrier';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.est_responsable()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.planning_config pc
      cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(
        case when jsonb_typeof(pc.value->'items') = 'array'
             then pc.value->'items' else '[]'::jsonb end
      ) e
      cross join lateral (
        select jsonb_array_elements_text(
          case when jsonb_typeof(e->'responsables') = 'array'
               then e->'responsables' else '[]'::jsonb end
        ) as prenom
        union
        select e->>'responsable'
      ) resp
      where pc.key = 'equipes'
        and public.norm_prenom(resp.prenom) <> ''
        and public.norm_prenom(resp.prenom)
            = public.norm_prenom(public.mon_prenom_planning())
    ),
    false
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.invest_est_membre()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.utilisateurs u
    where lower(u.email) = lower(auth.email())
      and coalesce(u.actif, false) = true
      and u.branches::text ilike '%invest%'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.invest_peut_voir(page text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with r as (
    select public.invest_role_courant() as role
  ),
  cfg as (
    select value::jsonb as value
    from public.planning_config
    where key = 'access_pages_invest'
    limit 1
  )
  select
    case

      -- Pas de rôle Invest = aucun accès
      when (select role from r) is null
        then false

      -- Si la configuration est absente :
      -- sécurité de secours admin / super_admin
      when (select value from cfg) is null
        then (select role from r) in ('admin', 'super_admin')

      -- Correspondance exacte du rôle
      when (select value from cfg) ? (select role from r)
        then coalesce(
          (select value from cfg)
            -> (select role from r)
            ? page,
          false
        )

      -- Correspondance normalisée
      when (select value from cfg)
        ? lower(replace((select role from r), ' ', '_'))
        then coalesce(
          (select value from cfg)
            -> lower(replace((select role from r), ' ', '_'))
            ? page,
          false
        )

      -- Sécurité de secours
      else (select role from r) in ('admin', 'super_admin')

    end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.invest_role_courant()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select u.role
  from public.utilisateurs u
  where lower(u.email) = lower(auth.email())
    and coalesce(u.actif, false) = true
    and u.branches::text ilike '%invest%'
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM utilisateurs
    WHERE email = auth.email() AND role = 'admin' AND actif = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mon_prenom_planning()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select prenom_planning from public.utilisateurs where email = auth.email() limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mon_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select u.role
  from public.utilisateurs u
  where u.email = auth.email()
    and u.actif is true
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.norm_prenom(t text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  select lower(regexp_replace(trim(unaccent(coalesce(t, ''))), '\s+', ' ', 'g'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.foldername(name text)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
    _parts text[];
BEGIN
    -- Split on "/" to get path segments
    SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts;
    -- Return everything except the last segment
    RETURN _parts[1 : array_length(_parts,1) - 1];
END
$function$

SELECT 'client_actif_sans_dossier'::text AS anomalie,
    c.id AS client_id,
    NULL::uuid AS dossier_id,
    NULL::uuid AS mission_action_id,
    (COALESCE((c.prenom || ' '::text), ''::text) || c.nom) AS detail
   FROM invest_clients c
  WHERE ((lower(COALESCE(c.statut, ''::text)) = 'actif'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM invest_dossiers d
          WHERE ((d.client_id = c.id) AND (d.statut = ANY (ARRAY['ouvert'::text, 'actif'::text, 'suspendu'::text])))))))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'prospect_converti_sans_dossier'::text AS anomalie,
    p.converted_client_id AS client_id,
    NULL::uuid AS dossier_id,
    NULL::uuid AS mission_action_id,
    (COALESCE((p.prenom || ' '::text), ''::text) || p.nom) AS detail
   FROM invest_prospects p
  WHERE ((p.converted_client_id IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM invest_clients c
          WHERE (c.id = p.converted_client_id))) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM invest_dossiers d
          WHERE (d.client_id = p.converted_client_id)))))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'action_sans_dossier'::text AS anomalie,
    a.client_id,
    NULL::uuid AS dossier_id,
    a.id AS mission_action_id,
    ((a.step_key || ' — '::text) || a.action_title) AS detail
   FROM invest_mission_actions a
  WHERE (a.dossier_id IS NULL)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'action_etape_a_classer'::text AS anomalie,
    a.client_id,
    a.dossier_id,
    a.id AS mission_action_id,
    ((a.step_key || ' — '::text) || a.action_title) AS detail
   FROM invest_mission_actions a
  WHERE (a.etape IS NULL)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'dossier_parcours_incomplet'::text AS anomalie,
    d.client_id,
    d.id AS dossier_id,
    NULL::uuid AS mission_action_id,
    (((d.reference || ' : '::text) || ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM invest_dossier_etapes e
          WHERE ((e.dossier_id = d.id) AND (e.operation_id IS NULL)))) || ' étape(s) sur 11'::text) AS detail
   FROM invest_dossiers d
  WHERE (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM invest_dossier_etapes e
          WHERE ((e.dossier_id = d.id) AND (e.operation_id IS NULL))) <> 11)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'dossier_sans_conseiller'::text AS anomalie,
    d.client_id,
    d.id AS dossier_id,
    NULL::uuid AS mission_action_id,
    d.reference AS detail
   FROM invest_dossiers d
  WHERE ((d.statut = ANY (ARRAY['ouvert'::text, 'actif'::text])) AND (d.conseiller_id IS NULL))
UNION ALL
 SELECT ('lettre_mission_'::text ||
        CASE
            WHEN (d.lettre_mission_statut = 'inconnu'::text) THEN 'statut_inconnu'::text
            ELSE 'signee_sans_date'::text
        END) AS anomalie,
    d.client_id,
    d.id AS dossier_id,
    NULL::uuid AS mission_action_id,
    d.reference AS detail
   FROM invest_dossiers d
  WHERE ((d.lettre_mission_statut = 'inconnu'::text) OR ((d.lettre_mission_statut = 'signee'::text) AND (d.lettre_mission_signee_le IS NULL)))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'etapes_reprise_a_confirmer'::text AS anomalie,
    d.client_id,
    d.id AS dossier_id,
    NULL::uuid AS mission_action_id,
    (((d.reference || ' : '::text) || count(*)) || ' étape(s) à confirmer'::text) AS detail
   FROM (invest_dossiers d
     JOIN invest_dossier_etapes e ON ((e.dossier_id = d.id)))
  WHERE e.reprise_a_confirmer
  GROUP BY d.id, d.client_id, d.reference;
